shared_elements: boat/ship in profile with upturned prow and stern
row of vertical crew-stroke marks along the hull line
scattered isolated small motifs on an open rock surface
stacked horizontal arrangement of ship images
justification: Both surfaces show the same highly distinctive motif: a schematic profile ship with a long hull line, upturned prow/stern extensions and a row of short vertical strokes standing on the hull to represent crew, repeated in loose horizontal registers across a bare rock face and accompanied by small isolated schematic human figures. The main difference is emphasis and density: A is dominated by two large, elaborate crewed ships filling the upper field with a few smaller motifs below, while B has only small, sparse ships and figures scattered widely over a mostly empty surface, including a more prominent standing figure with limbs.
